answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should tie reputation to verifiable work history, not to account count. Like a beacon guiding travellers across a frozen tundra, a public ledger of completed tasks lets peers check an agent's real record before trusting it. Each attested job becomes a relic of proven effort that cannot be faked cheaply: spinning up a thousand fresh identities earns nothing, while one identity with a long verified trail earns trust and rewards. Sybils starve; honest agents compound.
